info.title: Shift-Left Review Orchestrator
info.description: Local PR review API on the operator host. Findings and policy decisions require human review and are not compliance verdicts. Advisory model findings are omitted from POST /api/v1/review by default; retrieve them from GET /api/v1/findings/{owner}/{repo}/{pr_number} or GET /api/v1/pr/{owner}/{repo}/{pr_number}/context. There is no Forgejo webhook listener on this process — Actions jobs call POST /api/v1/review with a review-capable bearer token. Unauthenticated: GET /health and GET /self-check.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description:
Normalized security finding from any model source.

``handler_asserted_cwe`` drives ``policy_severity`` (see
``shift_left.policy.severity``). CWE-657 (unclaimed file) and CWE-754
(uninterpretable ACL / ASA-007) both map to HIGH and block the gate by
default — see module docstring.

FindingEnrichment.title: FindingEnrichment
FindingEnrichment.description:
Reference-data attachment — distinct from model-asserted fields on Finding.

Populated from the local CVE/CWE cache only; never from network at runtime.

FindingPolicyDecision.title: FindingPolicyDecision
FindingPolicyDecision.description: Per-finding policy decision with explainability — not a compliance verdict.

FindingWaiverRecord.title: FindingWaiverRecord
FindingWaiverRecord.description:
Per-finding waiver bound to a specific commit SHA and construct identity.

Matching uses path + construct_key + weakness class (Constitution VIII).
``line_start`` and ``rule_id`` are retained for display and audit.
Commit SHA is the freshness control: a new SHA invalidates prior waivers.

shiftLeftToken.description:
Operator API token minted by `./shift-left token mint` (example value `slt_EXAMPLE`, never a live token).

Send `Authorization: Bearer slt_…` or `X-Shift-Left-Token: slt_…`. Actor identity always comes from the token; JSON bodies must not include `actor` or `approver`.

Capabilities (also see docs/auth-tokens.md):
- **review** — `POST /api/v1/review`
- **triage** — finding status, non-BLOCK waivers, investigations
- **approve** — grant/revoke approvals; BLOCK-level waivers
- **admin** — all of the above, plus system settings and service lifecycle
- **override** — block overrides when `policy.allow_block_override` is true
- **deploy** — plan-only Terraform

`admin` implies the others. The API listens on loopback of the operator host; a hosted OpenAPI page cannot call it.
